acceptance_evidence.statement: Publishing a fixture graph with `ticket-graph-publish` produces a Mayor notification (test); the idle-ready-work condition fires after 15 min in a test with a fake clock.
A dispatch test covers every rig and formula through the door; the guard flags a synthetic raw `gc sling` in a test.
Re-dispatch test: a ticket with an existing branch and PR is handed to the next worker with that branch/PR; a re-planned ticket carries `supersedes`.
Escalation door test: each 'straight to Benjamin' case lands on the list; each 'Mayor first' case reaches the list only after 2 h; a failing escalation exits non-zero (no silent drop).
provider-failover test: all providers unavailable -> dispatch paused, list line written; reset -> dispatch resumes.
Guard tests: unpushed commit in a product-rig worktree is backed up; worktree with unpushed work is never removed; fresh branch spared 24 h; root-owned file reported.

Adding a third project in a test needs only a new `config/projects/*.toml`; a rig without a project file fails the check; `grep` finds no `saymyname`/`smb`/`smf` literal and no `/home/benja` path in `bin/`, `lib/`, `formulas/`, `orders/` outside comments.
`gc order list` matches the verdict table (skipped orders absent, overrides visible); 24 h after the last merge, `gc events` shows no `order.failed`.
`docs/INVENTORY.md` carries a written verdict for each of the 28 orders and each Mayor manual operation, and rows F11-F25 are closed or point to a ticket of this graph.
ADR-0028 amended; a patch test proves reorder/merge/supersede, rejection when acceptance criteria change, and author+reason recorded.
`bd metrics status` and `gc metrics status` report disabled; supervisor environment carries both opt-out variables.
The publish of this very graph leaves the live root clean (`git status` empty) once F18 is fixed.

behavior.statement: Wake: `bin/ticket-graph-publish` notifies the Mayor itself at the end of every successful publish (and patch). Safety net: when ready work has been idle > 15 min with no active worker, the Mayor is re-woken (a `condition` order).

Dispatch door: every dispatch, for every rig and every formula (`mol-do-work`, `build-basic`, role formulas), goes through one door script that validates target, formula and `--reassign`; raw `gc sling` is forbidden to the Mayor and a guard check reports any dispatch that bypassed the door.

Resume, don't redo: on re-dispatch the door finds the ticket's branch, PR and notes and hands them to the worker, who must continue them; a re-planned ticket carries `supersedes <old id>` and inherits the existing work; starting over is allowed only when the worker records in the ticket why the old work is unusable.
One NEEDS BENJAMIN list, fed by one escalation door (replacing `bin/campaign-pointer escalate`); no escalation may fail silently (no `>/dev/null || true`).

Straight to Benjamin: a decision only he owns (consent, personal data, spend, production, behaviour/acceptance change), Factory stopped (Mayor down > 10 min, all providers exhausted), a plan fully delivered. Mayor first, Benjamin only if unresolved after 2 h: an order failing repeatedly, a stuck PR or repeated red CI.
Total provider exhaustion: dispatch of new work pauses, resumes by itself at quota reset, and one line lands on the NEEDS BENJAMIN list.

Interim display: the operator session (Claude/Codex) shows the NEEDS BENJAMIN list and a one-line count of pending proposals at session start; this is transitional until C01 moves both to the cockpit.
Workers push their branch from the first commit and after each commit; the branch name is written on the ticket at claim time.

factory-guard's local-commit backup covers the product rigs too, detached HEADs included; worktree cleanup never uses an `rm -rf` fallback and keeps (and reports to the Mayor) any worktree holding unpushed or uncommitted work; a fresh branch with no own commit is spared 24 h.
No build/test runs as root in worker worktrees; the guard reports any root-owned file there.

One project file per project in the Factory (`config/projects/<project>.toml`: repos, protected branch, required CI); every script that today hardcodes SayMyName reads it; a check fails loudly when a rig known to Gas City has no project file.

A setup script enables `.githooks` on a fresh clone; the two local-only tests run in a nightly order whose failure pages the Mayor; tests use a synthetic operator (`operator-1`); runtime messages name the operator from config.
Pack orders are tuned only from `city.toml` (`[orders] skip`, `[[orders.overrides]]`), never forked; order triggers follow the per-order verdict table in `decisions`.
`events.jsonl` rotated archives are kept 14 days (`[events.rotation] archive_retain_age`); traces keep Gas City's built-in caps.
Backup freshness: the Mayor is paged when the JSONL archive has not been pushed for > 24 h while beads changed.

bd and gc usage telemetry are off for interactive use and for every order (`BD_DISABLE_METRICS=1`, `GC_DISABLE_USAGE_METRICS=1` in the supervisor environment); the stray untracked `.config/` in the live root and gc's pending local metrics queue are removed.

ADR-0028 is amended to decision 8: `ticket-graph-publish patch` can reorder, merge and supersede tickets; the Mayor may reslice without a Planning Run only when the tool proves the acceptance criteria unchanged, else the question goes to the NEEDS BENJAMIN list; every patch records author and reason; a worker's self-split tickets carry `split from <id>`.
A blocked ticket cannot close without a classification (repair / behaviour / topology); behaviour or topology opens a Planning Exception (af-zwhh0 wiring finished in the formulas).
Improvement ideas become tickets labelled `proposal`, never dispatched; each Planning Run starts by triaging them with Benjamin.

The Mayor's manual upkeep gestures become named scripts (`bin/factory-maintain <gesture>`) that check their own safety criteria before acting, log what they did and can be undone; the Mayor may call them freely; anything else stays ADMIN (Benjamin); a repetitive safe gesture becomes an order.
The router's reservation state lives in untracked runtime state, so a publish no longer dirties the live root (F18).

boundaries.statement: Target rigs: `agent-factory` (all code, orders, formulas, prompts, docs); `saymyname-backend` and `saymyname-frontend` only receive the SayMyName rig contracts moved out of Factory docs, as dedicated files (progressive disclosure: at most a one-line pointer in their `AGENTS.md`), by PR to `dev`.
Gas City and bd binaries and pack code are never modified; only city configuration.

The Mayor prompt changes only where this Spec changes a mechanism (dispatch door, escalation door, factory-maintain, patch rights, proposals); decision 7 stands (the Mayor never selects work on its own).
Every change reaches `main` through a Factory PR with a green battery; nothing is edited in the live root.

decisions.statement: Run form: Wayfinding Run with one Planning Decision per theme (framing, t1-t6), all resolved; source of intent and mechanism: `docs/planning/factory-operations-v2/decisions-log.md`.
Reservation handling for this very run: router runs with `--repo-root` on a `po/*` worktree; the rewritten reservation reaches `main` by PR.
Delivery: the Factory (Mayor + workers) delivers this graph; the PO agent intervenes only when a defect of the Factory's own mechanics blocks, and records it as an A5 finding.
PII guard (`bin/factory-pii-guard` and its hook/guard calls) is retired; the written rule in the SayMyName repo `knowledge/real-person-data.md` stays (Benjamin, Q4.3).
Unrouted tools (F15, F19, F20): each is wired when a theme needs it, else moved to `legacy/`; `claude-fable` is checked by the guard if used, else removed from `city.toml`.
SayMyName doc sections: rig contracts to product repos; host operations (Dolt backups) to a generic Factory doc; dead sections (old cutover, M6 rollback) to `legacy/`.

Order verdict `nudge-on-route`: keep (event).

Order verdict `nudge-mail-sweep`: skip (duplicates the controller's own sweep).

Order verdict `orphan-sweep`: keep.
Order verdict `spawn-storm-detect`: keep.
Order verdict `prune-branches`: skip (no `gc/*` branch; worktree/branch cleanup belongs to factory-maintain).

Order verdict `factory-guard`: keep; modified (product-rig backup, 24 h grace, root-file check, dispatch-bypass check, project files, factory-waiting-guard retired or re-justified: pr-autopilot still reads gc.waiting_on).
Order verdict `factory-watchdog`: keep; pages through the escalation door with the Mayor-first / 2 h rule; signals file retired.
Order verdict `pr-autopilot`: keep; reads project files instead of lib/protected_rigs.sh.
Order verdict `provider-failover`: keep; total exhaustion pauses dispatch, resumes at reset, NEEDS BENJAMIN line.
Order verdict `on-order-failed`: keep; escalates through the door (Mayor first, Benjamin after 2 h).
Order verdict `on-session-stranded`: keep; hands branch/PR of the stranded attempt to the next one.
Order verdict `convoy-parent-sweep`: retrigger on event `bead.closed`.
Order verdict `model-staleness-check`: move to `cron` daily.
New order `ready-work-idle` (condition): ready work idle > 15 min with no active worker re-wakes the Mayor.
New order `backup-freshness` (condition): archive not pushed > 24 h while beads changed pages the Mayor.
New order `local-only-tests` (cron nightly): runs the two local-only tests; failure pages the Mayor.

Mayor manual operations verdicts: read/answer mail — keep; dispatch — only through the dispatch door (raw `gc sling` forbidden); investigate guard beads — keep (20 min / 30 calls cap); end-of-turn report and handoff — keep; tier/formula choice — keep, validated by the door; split/merge/reorder — `ticket-graph-publish patch` under the acceptance-unchanged proof; Planning Exception — keep; escalate — escalation door (replaces campaign-pointer); PROPOSAL tickets — keep with label `proposal`; upkeep gestures — `bin/factory-maintain` scripts only; monitoring and CI reading — keep.

experiments.statement: Before any interval override, read the pack script to confirm it tolerates the longer gap.
Measure the count of cross-rig dependencies before skipping `cross-rig-deps`.
This run is the first real Planning Run since the one-way cutover (af-mav0b): any router, publish or dispatch defect met while running it is recorded as a finding and fixed inside this graph.

non_objectives.statement: No phone/cockpit channel (C01 owns ntfy and the cockpit; the session-start display is interim).
No fork or patch of Gas City or bd code; no upstream issue or PR.
No SayMyName product work, no dev -> main promotion.
No automated code re-review or autonomous self-improvement (rituals stay human-run).
No revival of the PII identifier-list guard.
